Albert Marni Joensen is a consultant physician (*overlæge*) and PhD working at Regionshospitalet Nordjylland in Hjørring [^src2] [^src3]. He plays a significant leadership role in the national quality assurance efforts for cardiovascular health in Denmark, specifically concerning the treatment of atrial fibrillation. 

Joensen serves as a co-chair of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] (the steering committee for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database), sharing the chairmanship with Lars Frost and Ulla Dam-Schmidt [^src1]. In this capacity, he is a core member of the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src2] [^src3]. His medical and academic expertise is instrumental in evaluating clinical indicator results and formulating the conclusions and recommendations presented in the database's annual reports [^src1]. These reports, published under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), document the quality of treatment for atrial fibrillation patients and serve as a critical foundation for both clinical practice and political decision-making in Denmark [^src2] [^src3].
